# Searchable Museum

> > A digital platform providing searchable access to the National Museum of African American History & Culture's collection, featuring interactive explorations of African American history, culture, and heritage.

This site serves as the online searchable database for NMAAHC, offering curated features on pivotal historical topics including slavery and emancipation, civil rights, historically Black institutions, and displaced African American communities. The platform connects museum objects, historical narratives, and cultural artifacts through interactive tools like Constellations.

## Key Topics

- National Museum of African American History & Culture
- African American History
- Slavery and Freedom
- Emancipation
- Civil Rights
- Historically Black Colleges and Universities
- Cultural Heritage
- Historical Objects
- Constellations (Interactive Exploration)
- Educational Resource
- Museum Collection Database
- Cultural Artifacts
- Philadelphia
- New Orleans
- Tuskegee University

## Core Features

- [Homepage](https://searchablemuseum.com/): Homepage for NMAAHC's searchable database of African American history
- [Constellations](https://www.searchablemuseum.com/constellations/): Interactive exploration connecting museum objects across African American history

## Historical Communities & Places

- [Emancipation Grounds](https://www.searchablemuseum.com/emancipation-grounds/): Educational feature on Emancipation Parks created by African Americans
- [Seneca Village](https://www.searchablemuseum.com/seneca-village/): Feature on Seneca Village, a displaced Black community in NYC
